nodes.description: Public uint256 totalSupply declared in Growth; set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in the Trendercoin constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) balances in Success; core ledger of token ownership for all derived contracts.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal allowed in theFuture; ERC20 allowance ledger.
string public constant name = 'Trendercoin' in Trendercoin.
string public constant symbol = 'TDC' in Trendercoin.
uint8 public constant decimals = 3 in Trendercoin.
uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 10000000000 * 10**3; used to seed totalSupply and the deployer balance.
SafeMaths.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant; multiplies then asserts a==0 || c/a==b.
SafeMaths.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant; Solidity auto-throws on division by zero.
SafeMaths.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant; asserts b <= a then returns a - b.
SafeMaths.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant; computes c = a + b and asserts c >= a.
Growth.balanceOf(address who) public constant returns (uint256); abstract declaration.
Growth.transfer(address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool); abstract declaration, emits Transfer.
Trender.allowance(address owner, address spender) public constant returns (uint256); abstract declaration.
Trender.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool); abstract declaration.
Trender.approve(address spender, uint256 value) public returns (bool); abstract declaration.
Success.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); debits msg.sender and credits _to after require checks, using SafeMaths.
Success.balanceOf(address _owner) public constant returns (uint256 balance); returns balances[_owner].
theFuture.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); moves balances and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
theFuture.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value (classic approve race).
theFuture.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public constant returns (uint256 remaining); returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
theFuture.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) public returns (bool success); adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] via SafeMaths.add.
theFuture.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) public returns (bool success); zeroes or subtracts via SafeMaths.sub with local oldValue.
Trendercoin() constructor; sets totalSupply = INITIAL_SUPPLY and balances[msg.sender] = INITIAL_SUPPLY (unprotected mint to deployer).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance keys and initial mint.
Arithmetic: balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside Success.transfer (SafeMaths-guarded subtraction).
Arithmetic: balances[_to].add(_value) inside Success.transfer (SafeMaths-guarded addition).
Arithmetic: balances[_from].sub(_value) inside theFuture.transferFrom.
Arithmetic: balances[_to].add(_value) inside theFuture.transferFrom.
Arithmetic: allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) inside theFuture.transferFrom.
Arithmetic: allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) inside increaseApproval; can be griefed toward allowance overflow limits.
Arithmetic: oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) inside decreaseApproval, plus the > comparison branch.
Arithmetic: uint256 c = a * b inside SafeMaths.mul; multiplication computed before the assert check.
Arithmetic: return a - b inside SafeMaths.sub after assert(b <= a).
Arithmetic: uint256 c = a + b inside SafeMaths.add; addition computed before the assert check.
Parameter _to of Success.transfer; destination address, must not be address(0).
Parameter _value of Success.transfer; amount to move, bounded by balances[msg.sender].
Parameter _from of theFuture.transferFrom; source of funds.
Parameter _to of theFuture.transferFrom; destination address.
Parameter _value of theFuture.transferFrom; amount bounded by balance and allowance.
Parameter _spender of theFuture.approve.
Parameter _value of theFuture.approve; directly overwrites the allowance.
Parameter _owner of theFuture.allowance.
Parameter _spender of theFuture.allowance.
Parameter _spender of theFuture.increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of theFuture.increaseApproval; added to existing allowance.
Parameter _spender of theFuture.decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of theFuture.decreaseApproval; compared to and subtracted from oldValue.
Parameter _owner of Success.balanceOf.
Parameter a of SafeMaths.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMaths.mul.
uint oldValue = allowed[msg.sender][_spender]; snapshot used for the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
Named return variable balance of Success.balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of theFuture.allowance.

edges.reason: Success.transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
Success.balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
theFuture.transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
theFuture.transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
theFuture.approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] without any check on the previous value.
theFuture.allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval accumulates into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reads and rewrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor writes totalSupply.
Constructor uses INITIAL_SUPPLY for totalSupply and the deployer balance.
Constructor mints INITIAL_SUPPLY into balances[msg.sender] with no access restriction.
msg.sender is the debited account in Success.transfer; its identity gates the transfer.
Allowance key allowed[_from][msg.sender] is checked against the caller in theFuture.transferFrom.
theFuture.approve grants allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
increaseApproval changes the allowance owned by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval changes the allowance owned by msg.sender.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token holder.
_to flows into the zero-address check and balance credit of Success.transfer.
_value flows into the balance check, subtraction and addition of Success.transfer.
_from flows into balance and allowance lookups of theFuture.transferFrom.
_to flows into the zero-address check and balance credit of theFuture.transferFrom.
_value flows into the balance/allowance checks and arithmetic of theFuture.transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key set by theFuture.approve.
_value is written verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner indexes allowed in theFuture.allowance.
_spender indexes allowed in theFuture.allowance.
_spender is the allowance key increased by increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the current allowance in increaseApproval.
_spender is the allowance key adjusted by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue drives the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
_owner indexes balances in Success.balanceOf.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication in SafeMaths.mul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication in SafeMaths.mul.
Local oldValue is read from and written back to the allowance in decreaseApproval.
Named return balance is assigned from balances[_owner].
Named return remaining is assigned from allowed[_owner][_spender].
Success.transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) (underflow-guarded arithmetic).
Success.transfer performs balances[_to].add(_value) (overflow-guarded arithmetic).
theFuture.transferFrom performs balances[_from].sub(_value).
theFuture.transferFrom performs balances[_to].add(_value).
theFuture.transferFrom performs allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value).
increaseApproval performs allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue).
decreaseApproval performs oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) with a comparison branch.
SafeMaths.mul computes c = a * b before asserting.
SafeMaths.sub returns a - b after assert(b <= a).
SafeMaths.add computes c = a + b before asserting.
Success.transfer calls SafeMaths.sub for the sender debit.
Success.transfer calls SafeMaths.add for the recipient credit.
theFuture.transferFrom calls SafeMaths.sub for balances and allowance debits.
theFuture.transferFrom calls SafeMaths.add for the recipient credit.
increaseApproval calls SafeMaths.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMaths.sub on the allowance.
Success.transfer implements the abstract Growth.transfer declaration.
theFuture.transferFrom overrides the abstract Trender.transferFrom declaration.
theFuture.approve implements the abstract Trender.approve declaration.
theFuture.allowance implements the abstract Trender.allowance declaration.
Success.balanceOf implements the abstract Growth.balanceOf declaration.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists as the destination argument of Success.transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _value is only consumed by Success.transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _from is only used by theFuture.transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _to is only used by theFuture.transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _value is only used by theFuture.transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _spender is only an index into allowed inside theFuture.approve.
The approve _value is the direct input of the allowance write that the approval arithmetic operations govern; merge into the related unsafe allowance operation.
Parameter _owner is only used as a lookup key in theFuture.allowance.
Parameter _spender is only used as a lookup key in theFuture.allowance.
Parameter _spender is only used as an allowance key in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is the addend of the allowance addition and belongs to the related unsafe arithmetic operation.
Parameter _spender is only used as an allowance key in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is the subtrahend of the allowance subtraction and belongs to the related unsafe arithmetic operation.
Parameter _owner is only used as the balances lookup key in Success.balanceOf.
Parameter a is only used inside SafeMaths.mul.
Parameter b is the multiplier of the multiplication guarded by SafeMaths.mul; merge into the related unsafe arithmetic operation.
oldValue is a short-lived snapshot whose only purpose is the comparison/subtraction inside decreaseApproval.
balance is just the named return value of Success.balanceOf and adds no independent semantics.
remaining is just the named return value of theFuture.allowance and adds no independent semantics.
